summary: Jurisdictional conflict in trans-border arbitration; lex-contractus (Indian law), lex-arbitri (Colombian law), lex-fori (Indian courts) analysis; conflicting clauses (Clause 16.5: Indian jurisdiction; Clause 18: Bogota arbitration); proper law of arbitration agreement vs law governing arbitration; Redfern & Hunter principles applied; Paul Smith Ltd. precedent cited; distinction between validity/scope of arbitration agreement and supervisory jurisdiction; appointment under Section 11(6) A&C Act upheld.
final_judgment: Petition allowed; appointment of arbitral panel under Section 11(6) directed; jurisdictional challenge rejected.
